content.value_statement: Complex schema work needs clear entity boundaries and relationships. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Mermaid models and CloudBase data-model tool use.
actual_capabilities: Routes simple MySQL and PostgreSQL tasks to the correct sibling skills.
Builds Mermaid classDiagram drafts for multi-entity relationship designs.
Maps business field meanings to supported CloudBase model field types.
Defines naming, required, unique, and display field conventions.
Guides manageDataModel reads and modifyDataModel create calls.
limitations: It is not the default path for simple SQL table changes.
It does not support document-database collection design.
The described creation flow does not update existing model structures.
Published models still require human validation before release.

use_cases.title: Design a Product Data Model
use_cases.description: Turn product requirements into entities, relationships, field types, and a reviewable Mermaid model.

use_cases.title: Prepare CloudBase Model Creation
use_cases.description: Check existing models, draft a new schema, and prepare a deliberate create action.

use_cases.title: Review Enterprise Schema Scope
use_cases.description: Keep complex relational designs small, consistent, and aligned before SQL implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Model
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small relationship model.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CloudBase data model for users and orders. Identify entities, relationships, fields, and a Mermaid classDiagram plan.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Requirements to Entities
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these product requirements and propose 3 to 5 core entities, relationship directions, field names, and required fields.

prompt_templates.title: Check Existing Model Fit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request before adding related models.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the available model inspection guidance to compare existing CloudBase models with a new billing model proposal.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Publish Decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this model plan for field names, uniqueness, required fields, relationship ownership, and whether it should be published now.

output_examples.input: A team needs users, orders, and products modeled for CloudBase.
output_examples.output: A concise entity plan with User, Order, and Product relationships, field choices, required fields, and review notes.

output_examples.input: A developer asks whether to use this skill for one MySQL table.
output_examples.output: A routing decision that recommends direct SQL tooling because diagram-driven modeling adds little value.

output_examples.input: A schema owner wants to create a new published model.
output_examples.output: A validation checklist covering display fields, uniqueness, required fields, relationship direction, and publish readiness.

best_practices: Confirm that Mermaid-based modeling is needed before using the skill.
Define core entities and relationships before drafting model details.
Validate required fields, uniqueness, and relationship direction before publishing.
anti_patterns: Using this skill for one or two simple SQL statements.
Mixing SQL table design with document collection design.
Publishing generated models before reviewing field constraints.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for complex CloudBase data models that benefit from Mermaid relationship diagrams.

faq.question: Can it create simple SQL tables?
faq.answer: It routes simple MySQL table work to direct relational database tooling.

faq.question: Does it support PostgreSQL schemas?
faq.answer: It directs PostgreSQL and CloudBase PG work to the PostgreSQL development skill.

faq.question: Can it update existing models?
faq.answer: The documented creation tool is create-only, so existing structure updates are not supported here.

faq.question: What output does it emphasize?
faq.answer: It emphasizes entity lists, relationship direction, field conventions, and Mermaid classDiagram modeling.

faq.question: Is publishing automatic?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends careful validation before any publish decision.
